ventral_fluke_pixel_intensity_distributi.global_contrast_ratio: Predominantly low-intensity (black) pixel distribution across approximately 80% of the visible surface, with high-intensity (white) pixels localized to the distal tips of both lobes.
ventral_fluke_pixel_intensity_distributi.spatial_color_mapping: High-contrast light-colored contiguous regions are located at the lateral extremities of both lobes. The left tip exhibits a feathered white region containing internal dark striations; the right tip contains an elongated white region intersected by distinct vertical dark banding.

trailing_edge_2d_geometric_contour.median_notch_angle: Deep, well-defined V-shaped central notch with a sharp vertex and an approximate internal angle of 75 degrees.
trailing_edge_2d_geometric_contour.edge_topography_serration_map: Continuous, irregular serration along the entire trailing edge boundary, with distinct jagged peaks of varying pixel-amplitude especially prominent on the lateral halves of both lobes.
trailing_edge_2d_geometric_contour.lobe_sweep_trajectory: Symmetrical upward-curving leading edges with a smooth convex sweep originating from the tips and descending towards the central median notch.

localized_surface_anomalies.rosette_scar_constellations: Dense concentration of small, circular white pixel clusters (speckling) visible near the central peduncle insertion point and along the proximal trailing edges.
localized_surface_anomalies.linear_abrasions: Distinct dark linear pixel disruptions (rake-like marks) are visible cutting through the high-intensity white patches on both the left and right distal tips.

acquired_anomalies_or_scars: Extensive white speckled scarring at the base/center of the fluke and dark linear rake marks on the white terminal patches of both lobes.
other_distinctive_markers: Unique 'zebra-stripe' pattern of dark vertical lines within the light-pigmented regions on the outer fluke edges.
